prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy process-documentation photograph in a copper-and-glass heatwork laboratory. Image 1 is visible-appearance guidance only for an original adult fictional woman: her visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Frame her at medium-wide three-quarter view beside a connected crucible, retort, condenser, and receiver, with warm furnace light and cool receiver backscatter sharing one believable lighting field. Depict an alchemist performing a visible material transmutation: one practitioner actively controls heat flow or material contact; retort crucible vessel and transfer path form one connected apparatus system; input and output material states remain simultaneously comparable; color texture phase or crystal structure changes at one bounded transition zone; condensate slag sediment vapor or heat discoloration traces the process. Dark mineral slurry enters the heated crucible as translucent crystalline fluid collects downstream through an amber-to-clear gradient. In the same causal frame, depict a summoner causing a distinct entity to arrive: one living operator performs a visible controlling action; one bounded source or threshold anchors the arrival; one separately embodied entity emerges rather than duplicating the operator; gesture gaze and entity orientation create a directional operator-to-arrival relation; dust light shadow or displaced objects respond locally to the arrival. Specifically, one separately embodied glass-and-vapor entity emerges into the room from the complete receiver mouth, oriented toward her raised directing hand, while its contact shadow and outward-pushed droplets ground the event.
